Q: Isolate substrings wrapped in square brackets A:

Did you get the result you expected (except for extra empty entries in the resulting Array)?
If your only Problem is just having empty Entries within your Array, you can quickly fix that with a combination of array_values() and array_filter() as demonstrated by the snippet below:

<?php

    $arr    = [
        '',
        'Vraag1? || Antwoord1',
        '',
        'Vraag2? || Antwoord2',
        '',
        'Vraag3? || Antwoord3',
        '',
    ];

    var_dump($arr);

    var_dump( array_values( array_filter($arr) ) );

Q: Jest custom render importing react-redux provider error A:

The reason for the error - is present in the error output. Jest is unable to parse a file.

By default Jest assumes everything inside node_modules is already valid JavaScript that can be executed, so it skips transforming the files for performance.

You're on the right track to fix the issue by adding transformIgnorePatterns - which tells Jest which packages which should not be skipped. You just need to additionally add react-redux to the regex.

Something like (just added |react-redux)

"transformIgnorePatterns": [
  "node_modules/(?!((jest-)?react-native|@react-native(-community)?)|expo(nent)?|@expo(nent)?/.*|@expo-google-fonts/.*|react-navigation|@react-navigation/.*|@unimodules/.*|unimodules|sentry-expo|native-base|react-native-svg|react-redux)"
]

Q: Google Apps Marketplace app installation callback A:

That was an intentional design change which is different than how it used to work in v1 of the marketplace.

If you need interactive setup, best thing to do is put in a check on login to see if the domain has been configured. You can use the licensing API to check for a marketplace install record or directory API to check user permissions if those matter for your use case.

If you just need to run a background task, you can periodically poll the licensing API to detect new installations of the app. This shouldn't be done too often, so if you need to do things before a user logs you're still better off going with a check on login to route them to the setup flow as needed.

Q: google-cloud/storage NodeJS library hangs when I try to file.save for file > ~512 KB A:

the behaviour or the delay you notice is because google-cloud/storage automatically switches from uploading at once or in 1 go to resumable upload when the file crosses the threshold size.

  • if the file size is around 1MB to 5MB then resumable uploading is not required. you can directly bypass by marking resumable flag as false inside options object of file.save() function:

    await file.save(fileBuffer, {resumable: false, contentType: 'application/octet-stream'});

  • if you are going with createWriteStream then pass it to configuration object itself
    const stream = file.createWrtieStream({resumable:false});

    also properly handle synchronous and asynchronous calls.
